gujarati_meaning: ભાઈ અથવા બહેન — એક જ માતા-પિતાના સંતાન.
usage_note: Gender-neutral term for brother or sister. Plural 'siblings' is very common.
examples: She has three siblings.
My siblings and I grew up in Gujarat.
Sibling rivalry is normal in families.
He is the youngest sibling.

english_meaning: A husband or wife; a married partner.
gujarati_meaning: પતિ અથવા પત્ની — લગ્નથી જોડાયેલ જીવનસાથી.
usage_note: Gender-neutral and formal term used in legal and official contexts.
memory_tip: 'Spouse' sounds like 'house' — the person who shares your house as your partner.
examples: Please include your spouse's name on the form.
His spouse accompanied him to the event.
She is the spouse of a well-known doctor.
The policy covers the employee and spouse.

english_meaning: A person from whom one is descended; a forefather.
gujarati_meaning: પૂર્વજ — જે વ્યક્તિઓ થી આપણો જન્મ-વંશ ચાલ્યો આવ્યો છે.
usage_note: 'Ancestor' refers to people further back than grandparents; grandparents can also qualify.
examples: My ancestors came from a small village in Saurashtra.
She traced her ancestors back 200 years.
Our ancestors built strong communities.
He is proud of his royal ancestors.

english_meaning: A person who is related to someone who lived in the past; offspring of a family line.
gujarati_meaning: વંશજ — ભૂતકાળની વ્યક્તિના કુળ સાથે સંબંધ ધરાવનાર.
usage_note: Opposite of 'ancestor'. Used in genealogy and historical contexts.
memory_tip: 'Descend' = નીચે આવવું → descendant = પેઢી-દર-પેઢી નીચે આવેલ વ્યક્તિ.
examples: She is a direct descendant of the Maratha warriors.
The descendants of the founder run the company today.
All descendants were invited to the reunion.
He identified as a descendant of African royalty.

english_meaning: A person who is legally responsible for the care of a child or another person.
gujarati_meaning: વાલી — જે વ્યક્તિ કાયદેસર રીતે બાળક અથવા અન્ય વ્યક્તિ માટે જવાબદાર છે.
usage_note: A guardian may not be a biological parent; it is a legal role.
examples: Her uncle became her legal guardian after her parents passed away.
The school requires guardian's signature.
He was appointed as guardian of the estate.
A guardian must act in the child's best interest.

english_meaning: A person who is married to one's biological parent but is not one's biological parent.
gujarati_meaning: સાવકા માતા-પિતા — જે વ્યક્તિ આપણા જૈવિક માતા-પિતા સાથે પરણ્યા છે, પણ જૈવિક નથી.
usage_note: The prefix 'step-' indicates a relationship through remarriage, not by blood.
memory_tip: 'Step' = પ્રેમ-સ્વીકારના પગલે → stepparent = લગ્ન દ્વારા મળેલ માતા-પિતા.
examples: Her stepparent was very caring and kind.
He built a strong bond with his stepparent.
Accepting a stepparent can take time for children.
Her stepmother attended all her school events.

english_meaning: A relative by marriage, especially a parent of one's spouse.
gujarati_meaning: સાસરિયા — લગ્ન દ્વારા મળેલ સ્વજન, ખાસ કરીને જીવનસાથીના માતા-પિતા.
usage_note: Typically refers to spouse's parents; the plural 'in-laws' means the entire family.
memory_tip: 'In law' = કાયદા/સમાજ મુજબ → in-law = સામાજિક/કાનૂની સ્વીકૃત સ્વજન.
examples: My in-laws are visiting next week.
She gets along well with her mother-in-law.
The in-laws hosted a grand dinner.
He respects his father-in-law deeply.

english_meaning: The male head of a family or tribe; an older, respected male leader.
gujarati_meaning: કુળ-વડો — પરિવાર કે સમાજનો વડો (પુરુષ), જે સૌ પ્રત્યે આદર ધરાવે.
usage_note: 'Patriarchy' refers to a system dominated by male authority; patriarch is the individual.
examples: The patriarch of the family made all major decisions.
He was the respected patriarch of the village.
The patriarch blessed the newlyweds.
As the patriarch, he was responsible for everyone.

english_meaning: The female head of a family or community.
gujarati_meaning: કુળ-વડી — પરિવાર કે સમાજની વડી (સ્ત્રી), જે સૌ ઉપર પ્રેમ-અધિકાર ધરાવે.
usage_note: In many Indian joint families, the grandmother acts as the matriarch.
examples: The matriarch kept the family together through hard times.
Grandmother was the matriarch of our large family.
The matriarch's word was law in the household.
She became the matriarch after her mother-in-law passed away.

english_meaning: A child whose parents have died.
gujarati_meaning: અનાથ — એ બાળક જેના માતા-પિતા બંને ગુજરી ગયા હોય.
usage_note: 'Orphaned' is the adjective form. An 'orphanage' is where orphans are cared for.
memory_tip: 'Or-phan' → think of a child without a family fan = orphan = અનાથ.
examples: The orphan was adopted by a loving family.
Many orphans live in the care home.
She volunteered at an orphanage every weekend.
The war left thousands of children orphaned.

english_meaning: A child who has been legally taken into a family as a son or daughter, though not born to them.
gujarati_meaning: દત્તક બાળક — જે બાળકને કાયદેસર પોતાના પરિવારમાં સ્વીકારવામાં આવ્યો હોય.
usage_note: 'Adopted' is the past participle of 'adopt'. An 'adoptee' is the formal term.
memory_tip: 'Adopt' = દત્તક લેવું → adopted child = દત્તક બાળક.
examples: Their adopted child is now a successful engineer.
The couple decided to adopt a child.
An adopted child has the same legal rights as a biological child.
She never felt different from her adopted family.

english_meaning: One of two children born to the same mother at the same time.
gujarati_meaning: જોડિયા — એક સાથે જ જન્મેલ બે બાળકોમાંથી એક.
usage_note: Identical twins share the same DNA; fraternal twins do not.
examples: She and her sister are identical twins.
The twins always wore matching clothes.
Fraternal twins can look very different.
He has a twin brother who lives in Canada.

english_meaning: A person who sponsors a child at baptism and is responsible for their religious upbringing.
gujarati_meaning: ધર્મ-વાલી — ધાર્મિક વિધિ (બાપ્ટિઝમ) વખતે બાળકને આશ્રય આપનાર વ્યક્તિ.
usage_note: Common in Christian families; the godparent plays a mentoring role.
examples: She asked her best friend to be her baby's godparent.
My godfather gave me good life advice.
The godparent attended all the child's milestones.
Being a godparent is a great responsibility.

english_meaning: A person connected to you by blood or marriage.
gujarati_meaning: સ્વજન/સગો — જે વ્યક્તિ સાથે લોહી અથવા લગ્ન દ્વારા સંબંધ હોય.
usage_note: 'Relative' and 'relation' are interchangeable; 'kin' is more formal or literary.
examples: We visited relatives in Ahmedabad last summer.
She has relatives all over the world.
A distant relative left her a house in his will.
My relatives always gather for Diwali.

english_meaning: The son of one's brother or sister.
usage_note: Male; for female, use 'niece'. Together, 'nibling' is a newer gender-neutral term.
memory_tip: 'Nephew' starts with N like 'nana no dikro' — ભાઈ/બહેનનો દીકરો.
examples: My nephew just started school this year.
She bought a gift for her nephew's birthday.
His nephew looks just like him.
The nephew inherited the family business.

english_meaning: The daughter of one's brother or sister.
usage_note: Female counterpart of 'nephew'. Both describe the same generational relationship.
memory_tip: 'Niece' has an 'i' — she is a 'nice' girl = ભત્રીજી.
examples: My niece is learning to play the piano.
She is the favourite niece of the family.
His niece won first prize in the drawing competition.
The niece visited her aunt every summer.

english_meaning: The child of one's uncle or aunt.
gujarati_meaning: પિત્રાઈ/મમેરા ભાઈ-બહેન — ફોઈ, કાકા, મામા, માસીના સંતાન.
usage_note: In Indian culture, cousins often feel as close as siblings.
memory_tip: 'Cousin' → think 'cuz' (because) we are family — cousin = પિત્રાઈ.
examples: I grew up with my cousins next door.
She is my first cousin on my mother's side.
We meet all our cousins at Navratri every year.
His cousin is getting married in December.
